content:
sophia: creating a compact 'manager starter sprint' checklist for new hires (first week + 30/60/90). aiming for a single-paragraph email managers can copy. quick review?

jas: love the sprint language. one thing: add hardware/access checklist (monitor, dongle, SSO) and how to escalate if IT is delayed.

linda: include a short template for the Day1 1:1 agenda so managers don't skip key points. also mention payroll/enrollment timing.

sophia: noted. adding an escalation path and a 1:1 agenda snippet. posting the copy-ready checklist below. keep it short so managers can paste into messages.

```
Manager starter sprint (copy-ready)
Pre-start (Week0):
- Open IT ticket for laptop, monitor, dongle, VPN, SSO (target: 5 business days before start)
- Assign a buddy and add a Day1 calendar with HR, team intro, and tech session
- Share role doc, expected OKRs, sample week1 tasks, and the "role starter kit" link
Day1 (in-person/remote):
- HR (20-30m): payroll enrollment, benefits overview, security basics
- Manager 1:1 (20m): quick agenda -> intro, communication prefs, priorities for weeks 1	6, immediate blockers, safety/escalations
- Team welcome (10-15m) + add to team roster
- Tech setup (buddy-led): confirm repo access, CI, run a basic test or demo
End of Week (Day5):
- Confirm new hire can run a basic workflow and open a small PR or ticket
- Manager assigns an initial bite-sized deliverable and reviews the 30/60/90 draft
- Schedule skip-level intro and a customer/support shadow in week 2 if relevant
Escalation & contacts:
- If hardware or SSO delayed >48h, ping #it-ops and cc your People Ops contact
- Compliance/security certs: schedule within first 72h where applicable
30/60/90 (manager-owned):
- 30d: complete core onboarding, first small deliverable, regular 1:1 cadence established
- 60d: owning cross-team tasks, measurable contributions to roadmap
- 90d: shipping independently and proposing next-quarter goals
```

jas: looks great. can we pin the "role starter kit" link in Notion and include an infra-specific quickstart link for eng hires?

linda: +1. also recommend managers set expectations about async response windows (e.g., 24h) during the first month. helps newcomers.

onboard-bot: Reminder: Manager starter sprint checklist will be emailed to hiring manager and buddy 24 hours before start.

sophia: thanks all 	6 will add pinned links and the infra quickstart. publishing the template now; DM me for role-specific variants.
_notes: Slack thread format: concise messages, mentions, code block for the checklist. No title field per agents.md.
